description: Resettable live demo of a synthetic B2B SaaS stream on Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

panels.title: Demo elapsed
panels.description: Time into the current take (mm:ss); idle when no demo is running.

targets.rawSql: SELECT elapsed_label FROM dash.demo_state
SELECT status FROM dash.demo_state
SELECT events_last_minute FROM dash.live_summary
SELECT active_accounts_15m FROM dash.live_summary

panels.title: Failed payments, 15m
panels.description: Failed live payments, excluding injected rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT payments_failed_15m FROM dash.live_summary
SELECT flags_15m FROM dash.live_summary

panels.title: Events per second
panels.description: Live events inserted per second (exponential gaps at DEMO_RATE).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, events FROM dash.live_events_per_second WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, table_name AS metric, events FROM dash.live_events_per_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sessions and active users per minute
panels.description: Excludes injected sessions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sessions, active_accounts, active_users FROM dash.live_sessions_per_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, feature AS metric, events FROM dash.live_feature_events WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Signups and payments per minute
panels.description: Excludes injected rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, signups, trials FROM dash.live_signups WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, succeeded AS payments_succeeded, failed AS payments_failed FROM dash.live_payments WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Flush latency and size
panels.description: One point per 1 s flush. Bars: events in the flush (right axis).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, latency_ms, rows_inserted FROM dash.batches WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT table_name, rows FROM dash.table_counts ORDER BY rows DESC

panels.title: Active accounts, 7 days
panels.description: Accounts with any active user in the last 7 days, including today's live sessions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT active_accounts_7d FROM dash.usage_summary

panels.title: Active users, 7 days
panels.description: Sum of each account's peak daily active users in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT active_users_7d FROM dash.usage_summary

panels.title: Signups, 30 days
panels.description: New accounts in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, signups FROM dash.daily_activity

panels.title: Trials, 30 days
panels.description: New business trials in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, trials FROM dash.daily_activity

panels.title: Signups and trials per day
panels.description: Days by event_ts, last 30 days up to today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, signups, trials FROM dash.daily_activity ORDER BY day

panels.title: Devices registered per day
panels.description: Days by event_ts, last 30 days up to today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, devices_registered FROM dash.daily_activity ORDER BY day

panels.title: Active accounts and users per day
panels.description: Days by event_ts, last 30 days up to today. Today counts distinct accounts and users with a live session. Active users on the right axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, active_accounts, active_users FROM dash.daily_activity ORDER BY day

panels.title: Feature attempts per day
panels.description: Days by event_ts, last 30 days up to today. Today counts live feature events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, attempts, gated_attempts FROM dash.daily_features ORDER BY day

panels.title: Invoiced, 7 days
panels.description: Invoice totals in USD over the last 7 days, excluding injected rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT invoiced_usd_7d FROM dash.billing_summary
SELECT payments_succeeded_7d FROM dash.billing_summary
SELECT payments_failed_7d FROM dash.billing_summary

panels.title: Payment failure rate, 7 days
panels.description: Failed / all payments. Injected and test-mode payments excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT failure_rate_7d FROM dash.billing_summary

panels.title: Invoiced USD per day
panels.description: Days by event_ts, last 30 days up to today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, invoiced_usd FROM dash.billing_daily ORDER BY day

panels.title: Payments succeeded vs failed per day
panels.description: Days by event_ts, last 30 days up to today. Injected and test-mode payments excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, payments_succeeded, payments_failed FROM dash.billing_daily ORDER BY day

panels.title: Payment failure rate per day
panels.description: Days by event_ts, last 30 days up to today. Empty days had no payments.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, failure_rate FROM dash.billing_daily ORDER BY day

panels.title: Flags per minute by type
panels.description: Live flags, including those on injected rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, flag_type AS metric, flags FROM dash.live_flags WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Latest flags
panels.description: The latest 20 live flags with reason.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, flag_type, table_name, row_key, score, reason FROM dash.latest_flags
SELECT scope, anomaly_type, injected, detected, recall FROM dash.outlier_recall

panels.title: Precision by flag type
panels.description: Precision = flags on injected rows / all flags of the type. Natural hits are flags on rows that were not injected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT flag_type, flags, on_injected_rows, natural_hits, precision FROM dash.flag_precision

panels.title: Model summary
panels.description: Warm: the baseline warm start. Live: trials resolved during demo takes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_name, phase, trials_resolved, conversion_rate, mean_prediction, cumulative_auc FROM dash.model_summary

panels.title: Top 10 open trials
panels.description: Open trials by the logistic regression's latest predicted conversion probability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT account_id, probability, points_probability, trial_started_at, trial_ends_at, updated_at FROM dash.top_open_trials

panels.title: Rolling AUC (last 100 resolved trials)
panels.description: Logistic regression vs the fixed points baseline, by trials resolved.

targets.rawSql: SELECT resolved_trials, logreg_auc, points_auc FROM dash.model_metrics
SELECT resolved_trials, logreg_log_loss, points_log_loss FROM dash.model_metrics

title: SaaS usage stream
